headline: Reserve Bank of India Rejects All Bids at Treasury Bill Sale Amid Bond Selloff
summary: The Reserve Bank of India rejected all bids at a federal treasury bill auction for the first time in seven months as an ongoing bond selloff drove borrowing costs to multi-year highs.
why: State debt auctions and central bank bidding interventions offer direct insights into sovereign liquidity constraints and domestic bond market stress.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Rejection of treasury bill bids signals rising sovereign borrowing costs and tighter domestic liquidity conditions.

why_moved: A broader bond selloff forced sovereign yields upward, prompting the central bank to reject bids rather than accept excessively high borrowing costs.
